description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter `TopNavAdapter` for displaying a top navigation bar with focus handling, specifically for Android TV applications. It manages a list of navigation items, including a special search icon token, with focus animations and edge navigation interception.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView ListAdapter for top navigation tabs, managing focus and click interactions including a special search item.

classes.name: TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual top navigation tab views, handling binding and focus/interaction logic.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for a navigation tab and creates its ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Sets up the view content, focus behavior, and click/key listeners for a navigation item.
